# Uninstall LaunchAgent

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `launchd.uninstall.task` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/launchd.yaml` |
| Tags | launchd, lifecycle |

Boots the job out of the user GUI domain and removes its `.plist` from
`~/Library/LaunchAgents/`. Safe to call against a job that is not
currently loaded.
